simple.summary: בֵּית הַמֶּרְחָק (Bêyth ham-Merchâq) means Beth-ham-Merchak , a place in Palestine First listed occurrence: 2Sam 15 17.

definitions.full: H1023. beth hammerchaq הַמֶּרְחָק בֵּית possibly proper name, of a location house or settlement on bank of Kidron 2Sam 15:17 (RV Beth-merhak , compare MV RVm Far House ; Ew The Ke Sta the last house of the city).
definitions.rootNote: from 1004 and 4801 with the article interposed; house of the breadth;
